verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a cloud file-conversion service with user accounts, so a data-export-and-leave capability is a fair question. The evidence covers converting and downloading individual files and deleting them early. It never documents a bulk export of a user's account data or history in open formats. Per-file conversion and deletion are adjacent features, not a data-portability export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
